'''Andurgo''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who left [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and served the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] in [[137 ABY]]. He was a member of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] to [[Monia Gahan]], and he considered himself the finest pilot of the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].

==Biography==
Andurgo was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s elite [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[137 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he welcomed the newest Rogue, former [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Hondo Karr]], to the squadron in what he considered the most hilarious way possible &mdash; by riding on him. But Karr refused to be ridden and began a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] fight. However, their fight was cut short by [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Jhoram Bey]]. Karr took the blame for the fight, and by doing so, he earned the respect of Andurgo. They made up by getting drunk.<ref name="leg20" />

Andurgo flew his [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]] in the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]], serving as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of [[Ronto (Klatooinian)|Ronto]]. His showboating antics almost got Ronto [[Death/Legends|killed]], angering fellow Rogue [[Anj Dahl]]. Luckily Ronto managed to eject and was captured by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]], but he was later [[Massacre of New Coral City|rescued]] by the [[Imperial Knight]]s [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]]. The Knights' actions planted the seed of an [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|alliance]] between the Galactic Alliance Remnant and deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="leg21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>

Andurgo later participated in the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]], the first joint [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Space warfare/Legends|action]] of the burgeoning alliance. Later in the year, when the Rogues were flying a reconnaissance patrol over Imperial-occupied-Dac, they discovered millions of corpses floating on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world's]] surface. The [[One Sith]] had released [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[viral spore]]s into the seas, enraging Andurgo and prompting him to disobey new Rogue Leader [[Anj Dahl]]'s commands and attack some nearby Imperial [[Predator-class fighter|TIE predators]]. His fellow Rogues swooped in to [[Dogfight above Dac|assist]] him, and Dahl ignored his insubordination due to the horrifying reality they faced. The Remnant's [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] quickly organized a volunteer [[emergency evac fleet]], and the Rogues joined in the [[evacuation of Dac]], which was only able to rescue twenty percent of the planet's population.

In [[138 ABY]], Rogue Squadron participated in the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|defense]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi's]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]], flying against [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]]. After this, they fought in a massive [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] held at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and in the skies above the planet, Andurgo was killed by an [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighter]].
